name: 뒷불 새디 · 저승길 차림
accessories: 머리 뒤에 떠 있는 황금빛 광륜
silhouette: 거대한 기하학적 날개와 육중한 대검, 머리 뒤의 커다란 광륜과 주변을 부유하는 작은 파편들
signature_motion: 대검을 바닥에 내리찍으며 주변으로 붉은 에너지를 폭발시킴
signature_vfx: 선명한 핏빛 입자가 광륜에서 뿜어져 나와 궤적을 남김
visual_en: A muscular metallic humanoid with pure white ceramic armor and heavy gold plating. A large, glowing golden halo floats behind the head. Six small, bright cyan fragments orbit the body. Massive, geometric wings made of shattered light extend from the back. The character holds a heavy plasma greatsword that emits intense blood-red energy. Glowing red light leaks from the gaps in the heavy chrome gauntlets and boots. The overall silhouette is dominated by the radiant halo and the sharp, fragmented wing structure.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing in a heavy, imposing stance with the greatsword planted in the ground.
vfx_en: Splattering patterns of vivid crimson light and plasma sparks.
motion_en: Heavy ground slam with an energy shockwave.

parent_body.body: A humanoid robotic character with white and gold armor, large white wings, and a helmeted head.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
